title: Prop 15.139: affine halfspaces + double Seidel–norm-circle; all p=7 H_+ size classes Max+-free; residual OPEN generally
settlement_note: No soft-close. Affine halfspaces give 56/84 at p=7 (AP dichotomy). Double switch covers 588/1176/294. Size classes Max+-free at p=7; residual still needs Max+-free Q_j weights for general p. N_ED4_SUF OPEN. L OPEN.

affine.theorem: Affine halfspaces y_{L,S} with |S|=(p+1)/2 are Max+ evecs at certified p=5,7 (all S, L=(0,1)).

ap_dichotomy.theorem: At p=7: S 4-AP ⇒ H_+ orbit size 84; S non-4-AP ⇒ size 56 (L=(0,1), all C(7,4)=35).

double_switch.theorem: y0∈Max+, C0=D_y0 C D_y0, C0 z=p z boolean ⇒ y=y0⊙z ∈ Max+ (Seidel dictionary; 15.138 with general base).

p7_sizes.theorem: At p=7 every H_+ size class {56,84,294,588,1176} has a Max+-free representative via affine halfspaces and/or double Seidel–norm-circle switch.

open.open: Max+-free weights w_t and character-sum Q_j(y_t) for every H_+ G-orbit (incl. four size-1176 orbits) for all primes p≥5; close ∑c_j²≤room. No soft-close from size-class coverage alone.
dead: norm circles alone for all types
soft-close L from p=5 + p=7 size classes (F3)

closed_forms.double_switch: y = y0 ⊙ z_nc(C0), C0=D_y0 C D_y0

open_attack: Character-sum Q_j on each Max+-free type (incl. mult-4 of size 1176); Max+-free weights; close residual for all p≥5.
